name: S34 point-in-time earnings and price momentum
hypothesis: Positive earnings surprises and upward forward EPS revisions add net predictive information beyond simple price momentum and Nasdaq exposure

execution.rebalance: First observed session of each calendar week, decision after close

selection: One fixed primary specification, no parameter search or post-result winner selection. All models use the same funded execution and trailing risk ceiling. No leverage until stock-selection evidence is established
evidence_gate: No performance output without reviewed point-in-time inputs, stable identifiers, historical universe membership, terminal/delisting coverage, timestamped original actuals and historical consensus/forward estimates
qualification: Historical comparisons are research screens, never proof of future alpha or automatic graduation. No currently unseen holdout is claimed; require a subsequent frozen prospective paper record
